rules.condition: Household lives in a house with a pucca roof and/or pucca wall, or in a house with more than 2 rooms (Annexure-I, Step 1: households meeting this are filtered out before any other check).
Owns 2.5 acres or more of irrigated land with at least one irrigation equipment (Annexure-I automatic-exclusion parameter 11).
Owns 5 acres or more of irrigated land used for two or more crop seasons (Annexure-I automatic-exclusion parameter 12).
Owns 7.5 acres or more of land with at least one irrigation equipment (Annexure-I automatic-exclusion parameter 13).
Any family member earns more than Rs.10,000 per month (Annexure-I automatic-exclusion parameter 6).
Household pays income tax (Annexure-I automatic-exclusion parameter 7).
Any household member is a Government employee (Annexure-I automatic-exclusion parameter 4).

notes: Core eligibility is primarily SECC 2011 housing-deprivation data verified by Gram Sabhas (page 25, para 4.1.1), not self-declared applicant input — the rules above cover the Annexure-I automatic-exclusion checklist (page 92) that can be approximated from the checker's profile fields.

Annexure-I automatic-exclusion parameters not modelled (no matching profile field collected): motorised two/three/four-wheeler or fishing boat ownership, mechanised agricultural equipment ownership, Kisan Credit Card with limit ≥Rs.50,000, registered non-agricultural enterprise, paying professional tax, owning a refrigerator, owning a landline phone (page 92).

60% of the national PMAY-G target is earmarked for SC/ST households (page 22, para 3.4.1) — this affects prioritisation/allocation, not individual eligibility, so it is not modelled as an exclusion rule.

Automatic-inclusion criteria (shelterless, destitute, manual scavengers, Primitive Tribal Groups, legally released bonded labourers — page 92) grant priority rather than gate eligibility, so they are not modelled as exclusion rules either.
